notes: The v2 control/checkpoint test asserts seatbelt enforcement, a real pause/step/checkpoint, requested stop and a confirmed empty process group.
The v2 idle test creates a real child process with idleMs=1000; it exits with exitFact.expired='idle' and confirmed=true under seatbelt.
The environment negative rewrites the checkpoint envelope to platform=plan9, arch=mips, node=v0.0.0 and expects 'invalid'.
No new distribution package was used; the test ran with the development Node/PostgreSQL resources on the same Mac.
